storyCards.headline: Royals: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Lorde's "Royals" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Royals" is the debut single by New Zealand singer-songwriter Lorde, included in her debut extended play (EP) The Love Club EP (2012) and debut studio album Pure Heroine (2013).

Lorde wrote the song with producer Joel Little.

"Royals" is a minimalist art pop and electropop song with influences of hip hop, R&B, and indie pop.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 44 weeks on the chart.
